scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && uv sync --directory backend
scripts.dev: npm run db:upgrade && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: rm -f backend/dev.db backend/dev.db-shm backend/dev.db-wal && npm run db:upgrade
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
